purpose: Assess the current live Matrix against enterprise architecture, AI management, internal control, security, quality, operations, commercial, finance and value-realization expectations.

resource_context.owner_attested: The Matrix was built/operated primarily with free models, free trials and non-enterprise/non-pro AI access.
resource_context.treatment: Resource constraint does NOT reduce absolute enterprise-control requirements. It is reported separately as capability-per-cost/resilience evidence.
observed_constraints: Free Render services exhibit sleep/wake 503 behavior.
Several browser/form/write routes are connector/auth limited.
Five active automation/task slots are constrained.

scoring.model: critical controls weight 2; normal controls weight 1; PASS=1, PARTIAL=0.5, FAIL/NOT_EVIDENCED=0
scoring.pass_rule: PASS requires >=90 absolute score, zero critical FAIL, and no unresolved executable queue affecting a critical control.

queue_condition: If FAIL, drain executable queue/reconciliation backlog before rerunning the same frozen D04 criteria; do not alter the criteria/oracle between runs.
